title: Jitra Half Marathon 2026 Review: Kedah's Darulaman Park 21K
seo_title: Jitra Half Marathon 2026 Review | Kedah Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Jitra Half Marathon 2026: September 19 at Darulaman Park, Jitra, Kedah. 21K, 10K, 5K from BDB Leisure with registration open — northern Malaysia's park-based race.
dek: Set for 19 September 2026 at Darulaman Park in Jitra, Kedah, this BDB Leisure-organised half marathon offers three distances with registration open. A northern Malaysian race with state-government backing.
verdict: The Jitra Half Marathon is a state-government-backed Kedah road race, organised by BDB Leisure (a subsidiary of Bina Darulaman Berhad, Kedah's state development corporation). Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. Darulaman Park provides a contained, park-based race precinct with dedicated roads and facilities. Jitra is a town in northern Kedah, roughly 30 minutes from Alor Setar and close to the Thai border. For runners wanting a northern Malaysian half marathon with government backing and open registration, this is a solid pick.

sections.heading: Kedah: Malaysia's Rice Bowl
paragraphs: Jitra is a town in northern Kedah — Malaysia's 'Rice Bowl' state, known for its paddy fields, its laid-back atmosphere, and its proximity to the Thai border. [1] BDB Leisure's state-government connection gives the race institutional backing. Darulaman Park is a landscaped recreational area with dedicated roads.

faqs.question: When is the Jitra Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 19 September 2026 at Darulaman Park, Jitra, Kedah, Malaysia. It offers 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is currently open. BDB Leisure Sdn. Bhd. (anjuran Bina Darulaman Berhad) organises the event. Entry costs RM80/65/50 (Early Bird until 31 May 2026), RM95/85/65 (1 Jun-31 Jul 2026) for 21km/10km/5km. [1]
